name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 1994 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 1994 record supports: the fifteen CERT/CC advisories CA-94:01 to CA-94:15 and the boundary advisory CA-95:01, GAO/AIMD-96-84 and the June 1996 Senate staff statement on the Rome Laboratory intrusions, the FBI history of the 1994 bank transfers, Shimomura's own account of the 25 December intrusion, F-Secure on One_Half, the KAOS4 record and the WildList of 1 September 1994. No 1994 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_1994.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
